subject: Post-call recap + POC re-baseline request (ACMECorp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Meera Patel <meera.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: POC scope & success criteria (next steps)

Hi Alex / Meera — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the trial:

Summary of agreed items:
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for product recommendations and conversational product assistant across web/channel.
- Initial success criteria (agreed):
  - Recommendation quality: NDCG@10 improvement >= 8% over current baseline on sampled traffic
  - Conversational accuracy: intent classification F1 >= 0.86 on evaluation set
  - Stability: no more than 1% error/timeout at peak load
- Evaluation plan: run a 3-week POC with staged scenarios (analytics harness + shadowing on 10% traffic), weekly checkpoints.
- Timeline: kickoff next Monday (10/19), 3-week trial, internal review 11/09.
- Ownership: Alex (ACME) — product owner; Meera — engineering lead; Marissa (Redwood) — POC lead; Rishi (Redwood) — infra & provisioning.

Attachments I will share: ACME_POC_SOW_v1 (scope, deliverables), eval-playbook template. Please confirm if these match what you expect.

Open questions / asks for ACME:
1) Any additional business-critical use cases we should include in the trial?
2) Any legal/security gating that will change the timeline (e.g., IP filters, allowed regions)?

Next steps (proposed):
- Meera to confirm engineering contact and any compliance constraints by EOD Wed (10/14).
- Redwood to send updated SOW and revised evaluation plan if ACME requests additional use cases.
- Confirm kickoff date 10/19 and staging window for smoke tests.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: eval-playbook.xlsx (spreadsheet with evaluation metrics and test harness steps)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC scope & success criteria (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few updates from our side after aligning with the product team:

1) Additional use case: we'd like to add a short "Search + reranking for product recommendations" use case. The goal is to improve relevance on PLP search by surfacing complementary products. Can we treat this as a second track during the POC (smaller traffic slice)?

2) Success criteria tweak: for online tests we need 95th percentile latency < 250ms (including network) for the recommendation endpoint. If Redwood can demonstrate both quality and latency thresholds on a 10% shadow traffic run, that would satisfy our infra bar.

3) Security: SOC 2 questionnaire is in progress. Legal asked for the updated SOW with explicit data handling sections before we sign.

If you can update the SOW to include the search/rerank track and the latency success metric, and push the kickoff by 1 week to allow internal approvals, that should work. Proposed kickoff 10/26 and keep the 3-week duration.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Product Analytics | ACMECorp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com
